title: Observability field journal — weekly trace & dashboard notes (2026-09-14)
content:
TL;DR:
Weekly sync notes from the observability on-call / engineering handshake. Focus this week: an experiment to reduce trace-cardinality cost by dialing adaptive sampling + a lightweight dashboard refresh for cost attribution per-model. Quick wins identified for alert tuning and a proposed pruning pass for span heatmaps.

Attendees:
- Priya Nair (notes)
- Martin Green
- Sofia Martinez
- Ethan Cole
- Lina Zhou
- Guest: Rahul (SRE rotation)

Standup snippets (morning):
- Martin: finished prototype of the sampling annealing controller, pushed to feature branch. Local sim shows 26% span reduction for low-QPS routes.
- Sofia: dashboard wireframes done; will swap out expensive left-join queries for pre-aggregated histograms. Need help verifying labels across model routing table.
- Ethan: cost telemetry pipeline ingestion backlog partially cleared; found that 8% of costs tagged as "unknown" are due to missing model_version in the agent tagging payload.
- Lina: KV-cache cold-start tracing added to dev cluster; collecting first 48h traces.

Action items (owners / ETA):
- OBS-A1: Integrate sampling annealing config into canary for two non-critical routes (search and rerank) — Martin / by 2026-09-20.
- OBS-A2: Add model_version fallback in the agent (populate as "unmapped" instead of blank) to reduce unknown cost buckets — Ethan / PR ready 2026-09-16.
- OBS-A3: Replace N+1 expensive joins in cost dashboard with daily pre-aggregates; deploy to staging — Sofia / 2026-09-22.
- OBS-A4: Heatmap pruning pass: script to remove span-level noise under 1ms and re-index heatmap tiles — Lina / draft 2026-09-21.
- OBS-A5: Runbook touch: document sampling thresholds and rollback steps for annealing controller — Priya / 2026-09-18.

Decisions made:
- We will experiment with adaptive sampling (annealing-style) instead of fixed-rate sampling for the week. Decision rationale: better preservation of tail traces, lower average cost than aggressive fixed sampling. Rollback criteria defined: if error investigations or alert noise increases by >15% vs baseline, revert immediately.
- Dashboard refresh will include an "attribution fallback" row for missing model_version to make cost reports actionable immediately.

Notes / Observations:
- Sampling annealing prototype (Martin): uses recent per-route error and latency variance to set sampling rate; cool-down period 12h. In sims with synthetic bursty traffic it reduced trace volume while preserving all high-error traces. Need to validate on real traffic.
- Edge-case: requests routed through fallback model variants are currently tagged with the canonical model id; we need to preserve variant id in the payload to avoid attribution bleed. Tracked in JIRA-OBS-423.
- Cost telemetry: a lot of cost spikes map to short-lived batch inference jobs (the daily fine-tuner job); propose adding a dedicated tag (job_type=scheduled_tuner) so dashboards can filter them out of product-facing attribution.
- Disk IO on the trace indexer spiked during the heatmap build last Thursday. Lina identified an NFS mount that had high latency; mitigation: move temp tile writes to local ephemeral SSD during build window.

Experiment plan: Adaptive sampling canary
- Target routes: /generate, /rerank (non-critical low-priority tier).
- Canary scope: 1% traffic initially, expand to 10% over 48h if no regressions.
- Metrics to monitor: traced-span-count, error-rate-by-route, alerting-noise, SLO-latency-99th.
- Observability: add a temporary dashboard tile with sample-rate-by-route and a diff column vs baseline.
- Rollback: manual rollback via feature-flag if error_rate delta > 15% or traced-span-count reduction exceeds 60% for high-error routes.

Dashboard notes (Sofia):
- New layout goals: fewer heavy joins in UI queries; happier downstream caching.
- Implement pre-aggregates with hourly shards keyed by (route, model_version, cost_bucket). That reduces compute for the top-level overview and makes model-level drilling fast.
- UX: add a one-click filter to remove scheduled batch jobs (job_type tag) and a row showing "unknown" attributions (links back to ingestion PR).

Cost-telemetry pipeline patch notes (Ethan):
- Patch: agent now sets model_version="unmapped" when missing. This reduces the unknown bucket in staging from 9.4% to 1.1% for a sample day.
- Follow-up: need a migration to backfill historical events with unmapped -> best-effort model_version from routing logs. Backfill strategy added to linked_artifacts.

Runbook & alerts:
- Updated runbook skeleton (Priya): includes steps to ramp down sampling annealer, how to toggle pre-aggregates, and quick commands for rebuilding heatmap tiles.
- Alert tuning: reduce noise from low-cardinality GC traces by increasing their aggregation window from 30s -> 2m. This will reduce spammy paging during rollout windows.

Blockers / risks:
- Risk: pre-aggregates require an index rebuild in staging; current indexer performance is borderline during business hours. Need to schedule a maintenance window or optimize the sharding.
- Blocker: the agent SDK change to set model_version requires a minor release — product signoff needed for change in semantic tagging. Waiting on product approval (P0).

Open questions:
1) What should the minimum kept sampling rate be for critical payment routes? (proposal: 10% floor)
2) Do we allow per-customer sampling overrides for high-volume enterprise tenants? (ops & product to weigh in)
3) Should scheduled batch jobs be hidden by default in cost dashboards for external reports?

Follow-ups for next sync:
- Martin to present canary telemetry after first 24h (quick dashboard snapshot).
- Ethan to open a short PR to backfill 7 days of unmapped model_version entries in staging, then run in dry-run mode.
- Sofia to push the staging dashboard with pre-aggregates behind a feature flag for PM review.
- Lina to test heatmap pruning script on a small shard and report IO profile.

Notes to self / scribbles:
- TODO: add a low-cost sampling curve example to runbook (ex: coeffs: [0.6, 0.4] for error/latency weighting).
- Reminder: coordinate with infra to get ephemeral SSD quota increased for heatmap builds (ticket infra-ssd-77).
- Slack thread: obs-trace -> thread-1592 has initial perf graphs.

Meeting adjourned at 11:05am PST.
Next sync: Monday 09:30am PST (standup + quick canary review).

---
Revision history (manual):
- 2026-09-14: initial notes (Priya).
- 2026-09-16: added agent patch results and updated action items (Ethan).
- 2026-09-17: minor edits and runbook task added (Priya).
